name: Hpakant jade mines
blurb: Jade mining has turned forested hills around Hpakant into open pits and spoil heaps.

name: Naypyitaw
blurb: A capital built on farmland and scrub from 2002: ministries, avenues and new reservoirs.

name: Yangon's growth
blurb: Hlaing Tharyar, Dagon Myothit and Thilawa spread over paddy land around the old city.

name: Monywa copper mines
blurb: Sabetaung–Kyisintaung and, from 2012, Letpadaung: open pits and leach pads west of the Chindwin.

name: Inle Lake
blurb: Floating gardens and silt have narrowed the open water, most in the north and west.

name: Yeywa reservoir
blurb: The Myitnge valley floods behind the Yeywa dam, completed in 2010.

name: Delta mangroves
blurb: Mangroves cleared for paddy and ponds around Bogale; Meinmahla Kyun stays forested.

name: Kyaukphyu
blurb: Town growth and the oil and gas terminal on Madae Island (white patch, south-east).
